I added `'Assets'[Manufacturer]` to the DataSet1 query and exposed it as a `Manufacturer` field. The existing fields are unchanged.

- **Query:** `'Assets'[Manufacturer]` sits right after `'Assets'[EquipmentType]` in the `SUMMARIZECOLUMNS` column list. The measures (`OperatingHours`, `IdleHours`, `FuelLitres`, `Utilization`) are untouched.
- **Field:** `Manufacturer` is bound to `Assets[Manufacturer]` as a `System.String`. I added it without the positional remap option, so the existing field bindings were not reshuffled.

The report validates against the schema. Lint raises one warning on `Utilization`: the DAX does return that column, so this looks like a false positive from the lint check. I did not change it. The lint also flags two unused data sources (`LegacySQL`, `ScratchPowerQuery`) and two date-like parameters typed as String (`DateFrom`, `DateTo`). These were already there and I left them alone.

The report has no tablix bound to the new field yet, so `Manufacturer` will not appear on the page until you add a column for it.
